pressure: Long-run archives need compact reentry surfaces, ledgers, receipts, validation, and explicit quarantine rather than only prose.
bounded_take: Adopt README/START_HERE/AGENTS/context/receipt/ledger grammar; keep it lighter than DelayBasin until pressure earns more machinery.
non_take: Do not import massive token-family governance language before this corpus has real records.

pressure: Claims need promotion gates, defeaters, rollback paths, and authority-dependency graph thinking.
bounded_take: Adopt evidence severity, status history, defeat/rollback language at schema level.
non_take: Do not pretend seed candidate cases have scientific authority.

pressure: A serious archive must be explicit about what has not been compiled/tested/proven; fail-closed warnings protect users.
bounded_take: Adopt fail-closed state for unverified records and evidence gates before promotion.
non_take: Do not import code-heavy cryptographic test machinery beyond a simple JSON/manifest lint pass.

pressure: A corpus-builder needs memory of searched, rejected, and selected items, not just finished entries.
bounded_take: Adopt searched-source/rejected-candidate memory as soon as source acquisition begins.
non_take: Do not use a pure monolith for this project; linked records and ledgers are more appropriate.

pressure: The project needed a directional center before it began accumulating records.
bounded_take: Name the mature object as a denominator graph and failure-literacy infrastructure.
non_take: Do not allow the direction memo to become a substitute for sourced case work.

pressure: The denominator-graph vision must begin with small, excellent records rather than more scaffolding.
bounded_take: Promote three official-source-backed engineering records and a provisional pattern candidate.
non_take: Do not promote replication/medical/genealogy records before similarly strong source work.

pressure: A warning-governance corpus built only from fatal famous disasters will overfit to catastrophe and miss the everyday denominator of near-misses and weak signals.
bounded_take: Promote ASRS/CHIRP/CIRAS/REPCON/NTSB source-infrastructure records as denominator-capture machinery.
non_take: Do not treat infrastructure existence as proof of hazard reduction or complete signal capture.
